verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's docs say it enforces SSO and MFA across all SAML- and OIDC-based apps, and one community user calls its SSO "not that bad." That same user had to figure most of the integration work out themselves, and nothing in the pack shows a pre-built app catalog or its size. missing for 10: evidence of a pre-built SSO app catalog, catalog size (thousands of integrations), evidence of minutes-level connector setup, independent hands-on corroboration of catalog coverage.
